modifications: none; upstream product files are installed without patches
configuration: English baseline, supplied X11/D-Bus/AT-SPI session, all product state and configuration under DATA_DIR; a first-run config.cfg turns off autosave, the start dialog and the version check and sets the embedded terminal shell to /usr/bin/true; the launcher confines the product with Landlock (restricted readable resources, execution only of the product binary and inert terminal shell, writes only DATA_DIR and exchange folders) and execs the unmodified release binary in the foreground.

notes.installation: The official Debian 13 amd64 package is unpacked with dpkg-deb; package maintainer scripts are not run.
